name: Steel Halberd: [Class Bonus] +1 POWER
notes: [Class Bonus] scans ALL physical field objects independent of the main champion (established technique, e.g. devoted-bloomweaver-class-bonus-empower): a physically-seeded WARRIOR champion (Jin, Fate Defiant) satisfies IsClassBonusActive(['WARRIOR']). A harmless Pass action is included because a step-0 assertion can't run -- the engine's game state isn't parsed into memory until the first action executes (DevTools/RunIntegrationTests.php:158 runs before RunnerPrepareTempGame's first EngineRunAction at :167) -- so the assertion runs at step 1 instead. Base POWER 1 + 1 from the bonus = 2.
